description: This Dart source file defines the `ApiService` class, which provides methods for user authentication, transaction management, and budget management via HTTP requests to a backend API in a Flutter application. It handles login, registration, adding/editing transactions, and adding/editing budgets, utilizing JSON encoding and shared preferences for token storage.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to interact with the backend API for authentication, transactions, and budget management.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returning an access token if successful.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Sends a request to add a new transaction with specified details.

methods.name: editTransaction
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction identified by ID.

methods.name: addBudget
methods.description: Creates a new budget category with a limit.

methods.name: editBudget
methods.description: Modifies an existing budget identified by ID.
